results.question: What did Carlos say about why AutoElite's extended warranty pricing is higher than some industry standards for Aiden Harris's SUV purchase?
results.gold_answer: The warranties are more comprehensive, covering a wider range of issues, and are backed by factory-trained technicians.

extraction.reason: Only one call features Carlos Mendes discussing why AutoElite's extended warranty pricing is higher than some industry standards for Aiden Harris's SUV purchase (the 2021-11-30 call on 'Aiden Harris's Fall Luxury SUV Purchase'). Other Carlos calls cover different topics (maintenance plans, financing, volume discounts) and do not address this question.

answers.answer: Carlos Mendes explained that AutoElite Motors' extended warranties are more comprehensive than some industry standards: they cover a wider range of potential issues and are backed by AutoElite's network of factory-trained technicians, ensuring that if something happens, the vehicle will be in the best hands. He added that their technicians receive specialized training directly from manufacturers (unlike at other dealerships), are highly skilled at handling issues quickly and efficiently, and have access to proprietary tools and resources — part of why the pricing reflects the more robust coverage.
